hypothesis: A separate short observable-decision gate avoids priming an event narrative; detail extraction only follows a positive gate. Synthetic negatives passed; real-video quality remains unproven.

selection.method: SHA256 seeded ordering of groups, then SHA256 seeded ordering of source hashes; one source per group; interleave by seeded source hash

decision.negative_meaning: No supported candidate in the sampled frames; not proof that the entire video is clear

control_acceptance.scope: Initial useful-signal gate on this small balanced TRAIN control, not a deployment or independent generalization claim

tune.quality_denominator: Completed videos; technical failures separately reported

stopping_rule: No threshold, prompt or seed selection after observing the control; on failure do not run TUNE. Holdout remains closed.
limitations: Small TRAIN control is not held-out evidence
Automatic groups await local human scene-family review
Sparse frames may miss short actions
Event types and evidence relevance lack independent annotations
